AddMonoid.content:
class AddMonoid (R : Type) where
  zero      : R
  add       : R → R → R
  add_zero  : ∀ x, add x zero = x
  add_comm  : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x
  add_assoc : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)

AddMonoid.add_zero.content: add_zero  : ∀ x, add x zero = x

AddMonoid.add_comm.content: add_comm  : ∀ x y, add x y = add y x

AddMonoid.add_assoc.content: add_assoc : ∀ x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)

integral_ext.content: axiom integral_ext   : ∀ (g h : R → R), (∀ θ, g θ = h θ) → integral g = integral h

integral_const.content: axiom integral_const : ∀ (c : R), integral (fun _ => c) = c

integral_add.content:
axiom integral_add   : ∀ (f g : R → R),
  integral (fun θ => AddMonoid.add (f θ) (g θ)) =
  AddMonoid.add (integral f) (integral g)

integral_shift.content:
axiom integral_shift : ∀ (f : R → R) (c : R),
  integral (fun θ => f (AddMonoid.add θ c)) = integral f

circleMap.content: def circleMap (c θ : R) : R := AddMonoid.add θ c

circleAverage.content:
noncomputable def circleAverage (f : R → R) (c : R) : R :=
  integral (fun θ => f (circleMap c θ))

theorem circleMap_zero (θ : R) :
  circleMap AddMonoid.zero θ = θ

theorem circleAverage_zero (f : R → R) :
  circleAverage f AddMonoid.zero = integral f

theorem circleAverage_add (f g : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) c =
  AddMonoid.add (circleAverage f c) (circleAverage g c)

circleAverage_fun_add.content:
theorem circleAverage_fun_add (f : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => f (AddMonoid.add z c)) AddMonoid.zero =
  circleAverage f c

circleMap_add.content:
theorem circleMap_add (c d θ : R) :
  circleMap (AddMonoid.add c d) θ =
  circleMap c (circleMap d θ)

circleAverage_shift.content:
theorem circleAverage_shift (f : R → R) (c d : R) :
  circleAverage f (AddMonoid.add c d) =
  circleAverage (fun z => f (AddMonoid.add z d)) c

circleAverage_const.content:
theorem circleAverage_const (k c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun _ => k) c = k

theorem circleAverage_comm_add (f g : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) c =
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (g z) (f z)) c

circleAverage_add_assoc.content:
theorem circleAverage_add_assoc (f g h : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) (h z)) c =
  AddMonoid.add (circleAverage f c)

theorem circleAverage_center_comm (f : R → R) (c d : R) :

theorem circleMap_zero (θ : R) :

theorem circleAverage_zero (f : R → R) :
  circleAverage f AddMonoid.zero = integral f := by
lean.proof:
dsimp [circleAverage]
  apply integral_ext; intro θ
  dsimp [circleMap]
  rw [AddMonoid.add_zero]

coq.statement: Lemma circleAverage_zero : forall f, circleAverage f zero = integral f.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f; unfold circleAverage.

theorem circleAverage_add (f g : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) c =

coq.statement:
Lemma circleAverage_add :    forall f g c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) (g z)) c =

coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f g c; unfold circleAverage.

lean.statement:
theorem circleAverage_fun_add (f : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => f (AddMonoid.add z c)) AddMonoid.zero =
  circleAverage f c := by
lean.proof:
dsimp [circleAverage, circleMap]
  apply integral_ext; intro θ
  rw [AddMonoid.add_comm]
  rw [←AddMonoid.add_assoc]
  rw [AddMonoid.add_zero]
  rw [AddMonoid.add_comm]

coq.statement:
Theorem circleAverage_fun_add :
    forall f c,
      circleAverage (fun z => f (add z c)) zero =
      circleAverage f c.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f c.
    unfold circleAverage, circleMap.
    apply integral_ext; intro θ.
    rewrite add_comm.
    rewrite <- (add_assoc c θ zero).
    rewrite add_zero.
    rewrite add_comm.
    reflexivity.

theorem circleMap_add (c d θ : R) :

coq.statement:
Lemma circleMap_add :    forall c d θ,
      circleMap (add c d) θ =
      circleMap c (circleMap d θ).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros c d θ; unfold circleMap.
    rewrite add_comm with (x := c) (y := d).
    rewrite add_assoc.
    rewrite <- add_assoc.
    reflexivity.

theorem circleAverage_shift (f : R → R) (c d : R) :

Lemma circleAverage_shift :    forall f c d,

coq.proof:
Proof.

theorem circleAverage_const (k c : R) :

lean.statement:
theorem circleAverage_add_const (f : R → R) (k c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (f z) k) c =
  AddMonoid.add (circleAverage f c) k := by

coq.statement:
Lemma circleAverage_add_const :    forall f k c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) k) c =
      add (circleAverage f c) k.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f k c; unfold circleAverage.
    replace (fun θ => add (f (circleMap c θ)) k)
      with (fun θ => add (f (circleMap c θ)) ((fun _ => k) θ))
      by reflexivity.
    rewrite integral_add.
    rewrite integral_const.
    reflexivity.

theorem circleAverage_comm_add (f g : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) c =
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (g z) (f z)) c := by
lean.proof:
dsimp [circleAverage]
  apply integral_ext; intro θ
  dsimp [circleMap]
  rw [AddMonoid.add_comm]

Lemma circleAverage_comm_add :    forall f g c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) (g z)) c =
      circleAverage (fun z => add (g z) (f z)) c.
coq.proof:

lean.statement:
theorem circleAverage_add_assoc (f g h : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => AddMonoid.add (AddMonoid.add (f z) (g z)) (h z)) c =
  AddMonoid.add (circleAverage f c)
              (AddMonoid.add (circleAverage g c) (circleAverage h c)) := by

coq.statement:
Lemma circleAverage_add_assoc :    forall f g h c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (add (f z) (g z)) (h z)) c =
      add (circleAverage f c)
          (add (circleAverage g c) (circleAverage h c)).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f g h c; unfold circleAverage.

    replace
      (fun θ => add (add (f (circleMap c θ)) (g (circleMap c θ)))
                    (h (circleMap c θ)))
      with
      (fun θ => add (add (f (circleMap c θ)) (g (circleMap c θ)))
                    ((fun θ => h (circleMap c θ)) θ))
      by reflexivity.
    rewrite integral_add.

    replace
      (integral (fun θ => add (f (circleMap c θ)) (g (circleMap c θ))))
      with
      (add (integral (fun θ => f (circleMap c θ)))
           (integral (fun θ => g (circleMap c θ))))
      by (rewrite integral_add; reflexivity).

    rewrite add_assoc.
    reflexivity.

theorem circleAverage_center_comm (f : R → R) (c d : R) :
  circleAverage f (AddMonoid.add c d) =
  circleAverage f (AddMonoid.add d c) := by
lean.proof:
dsimp [circleAverage, circleMap]
  apply integral_ext; intro θ
  simp [AddMonoid.add_comm]

coq.statement:
Lemma circleAverage_center_comm :    forall f c d,
      circleAverage f (add c d) =
      circleAverage f (add d c).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f c d.
    unfold circleAverage, circleMap.
    apply integral_ext; intro θ.
    rewrite (f_equal (fun x => add θ x) (add_comm c d)).
    reflexivity.

lean.statement:
theorem circleAverage_center_independent (f : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage f c = integral f := by

coq.statement:
Lemma circleAverage_center_independent :    forall f c,
      circleAverage f c = integral f.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f c; unfold circleAverage; apply integral_shift.

lean.statement:
theorem circleAverage_center_eq (f : R → R) (c d : R) :
  circleAverage f c = circleAverage f d := by
lean.proof:
have h1 := circleAverage_center_independent f c
  have h2 := circleAverage_center_independent f d
  exact Eq.trans h1 (Eq.symm h2)

coq.statement:
Lemma circleAverage_center_eq :    forall f c d,
      circleAverage f c = circleAverage f d.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f c d.
    rewrite (circleAverage_center_independent f c).
    rewrite (circleAverage_center_independent f d).
    reflexivity.

lean.statement:
theorem circleAverage_idempotent (f : R → R) (c : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => circleAverage f z) c = circleAverage f c := by
lean.proof:
dsimp [circleAverage]
  have h1 := by
    apply integral_ext; intro θ
    apply circleAverage_center_independent f (circleMap c θ)
  have h2 := integral_const (integral f)
  have h3 := circleAverage_center_independent f c
  exact Eq.trans (Eq.trans h1 h2) (Eq.symm h3)

coq.statement:
Lemma circleAverage_idempotent :  forall f c,
    circleAverage (fun z => circleAverage f z) c = circleAverage f c.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f c.
    rewrite (circleAverage_center_independent f c).
    unfold circleAverage.
    rewrite <- (integral_const (integral f)).
    apply integral_ext with (h := fun _ => integral f).
    intros θ.
    apply (circleAverage_center_independent f (circleMap c θ)).

theorem circleAverage_of_zero_integral (f : R → R) (c : R) (H : integral f = AddMonoid.zero) :

Lemma circleAverage_of_zero_integral :    forall f c,

coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros f c H.
    rewrite circleAverage_center_independent.
    assumption.

theorem circleAverage_linear (f g : R → R) (c : R) :

theorem circleAverage_shift_commute (f : R → R) (c d : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => f (circleMap d z)) c =

coq.statement:
Lemma circleAverage_shift_commute :    forall f c d,

Proof.

theorem circleAverage_shift_commute (f : R → R) (c d : R) :
  circleAverage (fun z => f (circleMap d z)) c =
  circleAverage f (AddMonoid.add c d) := by
  dsimp [circleAverage, circleMap]
  apply integral_ext; intro θ
  rw [AddMonoid.add_assoc]

add_zero.content: add_zero  : forall x, add x zero = x;

add_comm.content: add_comm  : forall x y, add x y = add y x;

add_assoc.content: add_assoc : forall x y z, add (add x y) z = add x (add y z)

integral_ext.content:
Axiom integral_ext   : forall g h,
      (forall θ, g θ = h θ) ->
      integral g = integral h.

integral_const.content:
Axiom integral_const : forall c,
      integral (fun _ => c) = c.

integral_add.content:
Axiom integral_add   : forall f g,
      integral (fun θ => add (f θ) (g θ)) =
      add (integral f) (integral g).

integral_shift.content:
Axiom integral_shift : forall f c,
    integral (fun θ => f (add θ c)) = integral f.

circleMap.content: Definition circleMap (c θ : R) : R := add θ c.

circleAverage.content:
Definition circleAverage (f : R -> R) (c : R) : R :=
    integral (fun θ => f (circleMap c θ)).

circleMap_zero.content:
Lemma circleMap_zero :
    forall θ, circleMap zero θ = θ.
  Proof.
    intros θ; unfold circleMap.
    rewrite add_zero; reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_zero.content:
Lemma circleAverage_zero :
    forall f, circleAverage f zero = integral f.
  Proof.
    intros f; unfold circleAverage.
    apply integral_ext; intros θ.
    now rewrite circleMap_zero.
  Qed.

circleAverage_add.content:
Lemma circleAverage_add :
    forall f g c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) (g z)) c =
      add (circleAverage f c) (circleAverage g c).
  Proof.
    intros f g c; unfold circleAverage.
    rewrite integral_add; reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_fun_add.content:
Theorem circleAverage_fun_add :
    forall f c,
      circleAverage (fun z => f (add z c)) zero =
      circleAverage f c.
  Proof.
    intros f c.
    unfold circleAverage, circleMap.
    apply integral_ext; intro θ.
    rewrite add_comm.
    rewrite <- (add_assoc c θ zero).
    rewrite add_zero.
    rewrite add_comm.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleMap_add.content:
Lemma circleMap_add :
    forall c d θ,
      circleMap (add c d) θ =
      circleMap c (circleMap d θ).
  Proof.
    intros c d θ; unfold circleMap.
    rewrite add_comm with (x := c) (y := d).
    rewrite add_assoc.
    rewrite <- add_assoc.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_shift.content:
Lemma circleAverage_shift :
    forall f c d,
      circleAverage f (add c d) =
      circleAverage (fun z => f (add z d)) c.
  Proof.
    intros f c d.
    unfold circleAverage.
    apply integral_ext; intro θ.
    unfold circleMap.
    rewrite add_assoc; reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_const.content:
Lemma circleAverage_const :
    forall k c, circleAverage (fun _ => k) c = k.
  Proof.
    intros k c; unfold circleAverage.
    rewrite integral_const; reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_add_const.content:
Lemma circleAverage_add_const :
    forall f k c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) k) c =
      add (circleAverage f c) k.
  Proof.
    intros f k c; unfold circleAverage.
    replace (fun θ => add (f (circleMap c θ)) k)
      with (fun θ => add (f (circleMap c θ)) ((fun _ => k) θ))
      by reflexivity.
    rewrite integral_add.
    rewrite integral_const.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_comm_add.content:
Lemma circleAverage_comm_add :
    forall f g c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) (g z)) c =
      circleAverage (fun z => add (g z) (f z)) c.
  Proof.
    intros f g c; unfold circleAverage.
    apply integral_ext; intro θ.
    rewrite add_comm; reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_add_assoc.content:
Lemma circleAverage_add_assoc :
    forall f g h c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (add (f z) (g z)) (h z)) c =
      add (circleAverage f c)
          (add (circleAverage g c) (circleAverage h c)).
  Proof.
    intros f g h c; unfold circleAverage.

    replace
      (fun θ => add (add (f (circleMap c θ)) (g (circleMap c θ)))
                    (h (circleMap c θ)))
      with
      (fun θ => add (add (f (circleMap c θ)) (g (circleMap c θ)))
                    ((fun θ => h (circleMap c θ)) θ))
      by reflexivity.
    rewrite integral_add.

    replace
      (integral (fun θ => add (f (circleMap c θ)) (g (circleMap c θ))))
      with
      (add (integral (fun θ => f (circleMap c θ)))
           (integral (fun θ => g (circleMap c θ))))
      by (rewrite integral_add; reflexivity).

    rewrite add_assoc.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_center_comm.content:
Lemma circleAverage_center_comm :
    forall f c d,
      circleAverage f (add c d) =
      circleAverage f (add d c).
  Proof.
    intros f c d.
    unfold circleAverage, circleMap.
    apply integral_ext; intro θ.
    rewrite (f_equal (fun x => add θ x) (add_comm c d)).
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_center_independent.content:
Lemma circleAverage_center_independent :
    forall f c,
      circleAverage f c = integral f.
  Proof.
    intros f c; unfold circleAverage; apply integral_shift.
  Qed.

circleAverage_center_eq.content:
Lemma circleAverage_center_eq :
    forall f c d,
      circleAverage f c = circleAverage f d.
  Proof.
    intros f c d.
    rewrite (circleAverage_center_independent f c).
    rewrite (circleAverage_center_independent f d).
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_idempotent.content:
Lemma circleAverage_idempotent :
  forall f c,
    circleAverage (fun z => circleAverage f z) c = circleAverage f c.
  Proof.
    intros f c.
    rewrite (circleAverage_center_independent f c).
    unfold circleAverage.
    rewrite <- (integral_const (integral f)).
    apply integral_ext with (h := fun _ => integral f).
    intros θ.
    apply (circleAverage_center_independent f (circleMap c θ)).
  Qed.

circleAverage_of_zero_integral.content:
Lemma circleAverage_of_zero_integral :
    forall f c,
      integral f = zero -> circleAverage f c = zero.
  Proof.
    intros f c H.
    rewrite circleAverage_center_independent.
    assumption.
  Qed.

circleAverage_linear.content:
Lemma circleAverage_linear :
    forall f g c,
      circleAverage (fun z => add (f z) (g z)) c =
      add (circleAverage f c) (circleAverage g c).
  Proof.
    intros f g c.
    unfold circleAverage.
    rewrite integral_add.
    reflexivity.
  Qed.

circleAverage_shift_commute.content:
Lemma circleAverage_shift_commute :
    forall f c d,
      circleAverage (fun z => f (circleMap d z)) c =
      circleAverage f (add c d).
  Proof.
    intros f c d.
    unfold circleAverage, circleMap.
    apply integral_ext.
    intros θ; rewrite add_assoc; reflexivity.
  Qed.
